 At Jammu

sentences.text:
The appellant is an owner of a private vehicle(I-10) bearing registration No.JK02BB-0101 which came to suffer damage on account of road traffic accident caused by offending Matadoor bearing registration No.JK02AA-0960 owned by the respondent No. 1 -Mohd. Sadiq and driven by the respondent No. 2- Kaka Hussain and which offending matador was insured with the respondent No.
3 -New India Assurance Company.

The accident came to take place on 16.03.2014 resulting in registration of FIR No. 63/2014 with the Police Station Bahu Fort Jammu.
02.
The appellant's damaged vehicle was also insured with the appellant's insurer i.e. Future Generali India Insurance Company.

The total cost for which the appellant had come to make the purchase of the damaged vehicle was Rs. 5 lacs which included the price of the accessories provided therein and on account of the damage caused by the accident, the appellant's vehicle is said to have been rendered as junk whereas before the accident taking place, the depreciated sale value of the appellant's vehicle was Rs. 4 lacs.

The appellant came to claim a compensation of an amount of Rs.
4,53,000/-.

Taking the fact that the appellant had received an amount of Rs. 1,40,000/- lacs from Balbir Singh Manhas vs Mohd. Sadiq And Others on 6 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29840500/
1

his insurer i.e. Future Generali India Insurance Company, the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal,
MACT Jammu came to hold that it was not in a position to assess the damages caused to the appellant's vehicle and also not in a position to calculate/assess the value of the appellant's vehicle and finally came to dismiss the claim petition vide an award dated 06.11.2023 against which the appellant being aggrieved is coming forward with the appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

03. Since the appeal is time barred involving delay of 68 days, as such, an application CM No.
2418/2024 seeking condonation of delay has also been preferred.
04. For the reasons stated in the application same is allowed and the main appeal is taken on record.
05. Condonation application is, accordingly, disposed of.
The appellant to furnish registered postal covers for the service of the respondents within a period of ten days, whereupon the Registrar Judicial, Jammu to issue notice to the respondents.
